config.notes: T5 100-record overfit test: 100 synthetic train records x 16 epochs = 1600 micro-batches = 200 optimizer steps (effective batch 8). Checkpoints every 100 steps (checkpoint-000100, final adapter). Purpose: prove format/answer-EOS/location learning and the CPU-preflight visual-token contract before any full SFT. GPU execution requires an explicit Lead lease.

id_intersection.requirement: train/val ID intersection must be exactly 0

evidence.warning_text: Model config: pad_token_id must be `None` or an integer within the vocabulary (between 0 and 31999), got 128002. This may result in unexpected behavior.
evidence.warning_source: transformers/models/idefics3/configuration_idefics3.py: class Idefics3Config default pad_token_id = 128_002, validated against the legacy 32000-entry default text vocabulary in configuration_utils.validate_token_ids
evidence.conclusion: 128002 is only the Idefics3Config class-level default for top-level pad_token_id; the tokenizer, generation_config and text config all resolve to pad=2 / eos=49279. SFT explicitly appends eos=49279 to every answer and uses pad=2 for collation, so the warning is documented and does not affect the training contract.

resume_contract: resume is allowed only when config_fingerprint, seed, model file hashes, dataset hashes, image_seq_len and EOS/pad ids all match
